bundleSuggestion: Bundle with Shakespeare decks (Bard's Barnyard Beatdown, Uncle FrizzleBob's Tragic Flaws) as LITERARY CARNAGE bundle

cards.lore: He sat on the gold until Loki squeezed him like a stress ball. It's not hoarding if you're underground.
cards.power: Asset Freeze: Target player cannot draw cards next turn. They are auditing their hoard.

cards.lore: He caught the pike, killed the otter, and enslaved the dwarf. Basically, a standard consultant.
cards.power: Forced Liquidation: Steal a card from an opponent. If they complain, steal another.

cards.lore: Andvaranaut. It breeds gold, but it eats owners. The ultimate pyramid scheme.
cards.power: Compound Interest: The holder gains +2 Attack but must discard a card every turn. The debt always wins.

cards.lore: Death to the owner. Joy to no one. Until the gold returns to the water everyone is just renting their life.
cards.power: Bad Ending: Attach to a Hero Card. That Hero dies at the end of the round. No saves.

cards.lore: Strong enough to kill a dragon. Dumb enough to not check his blind spot. The ultimate himbo.
cards.power: Main Character Syndrome: You cannot lose a duel unless the opponent is literally a god.

cards.lore: Bathe in the blood of your enemies — it's great for your skin. Also great for people who don't moisturize.
cards.power: Thick Skin: Ignore all damage from non-magical weapons. You smell great. You are legally invincible.

cards.lore: One tiny leaf. The giant design flaw. Every great hero hates perfection.
cards.power: Critical Fall: Play on an opponent's Hero Card. Their Defense drops to 0.

cards.lore: Subtlety is for people who can't cleave an anvil in half.
cards.power: Overkill: +4 Attack, but if this kills the target, destroys opponent's weapon card too.

cards.lore: King of Burgundy. Brave leader, as long as someone else is doing the fighting, wooing, and thinking.
cards.power: Delegate Authority: When challenged, force another player to fight for you.

cards.lore: Invisibility cloak. Great for wrestling women who are stronger than you without them knowing. Creepy.
cards.power: Assist Mode: Add Siegfried's Attack stats to Gunther's roll. Invisible cheating is still cheating.

cards.lore: He stands there, she fights him. He takes the credit. The original deepfake technology.
cards.power: Identity Theft: Swap hand cards with another player. Claim it was a misunderstanding.

cards.lore: A long voyage to find a woman who can kill you with a pebble. Men are idiots.
cards.power: Travel Montage: Skip a turn to draw 3 cards.

cards.lore: Queen of Iceland. Throws boulders for fun. Virginity is her power source (allegedly).
cards.power: Gatekeeper: Challenge an incoming player. If they lose, they are eliminated from the game.

cards.lore: If you can't lift this, don't ask for her hand.
cards.power: Heavy Artillery: Deal 5 damage. If the target is 'Gunther', deal 10.

cards.lore: It went through the shield, the armor, and the ego. Gunther fainted watching it.
cards.power: Shield Breaker: Ignore opponent's Defense stats this turn.

cards.lore: She tied the King up and hung him on the wall until morning. The most honest interaction in the whole saga.
cards.power: Time Out: Suspend an opponent's Hero card for one round. They cannot act.

cards.lore: The lights went out, and the 'King' suddenly got very strong. Kayfabe at its finest.
cards.power: Tag Team: Play this card to double your Attack for one turn, then lose 2 Health.

cards.lore: Steal it as a souvenir. Proof of conquest. Also, proof of being a terrible brother-in-law.
cards.power: Disempower: Target loses all special abilities. Without the belt, the magic is gone.

cards.lore: He gave the other woman's ring to his wife. Rookie mistake. Tactical suicide.
cards.power: Evidence: Reveal this card to start a war between two players.

cards.lore: Once she lost her virginity, she lost her strength. Ancient writers really didn't understand how women work.
cards.power: Depower: Change Brunhild's stats to 1/1/1.

cards.lore: He's not a villain. He's the only guy in the story who actually does his job. Digs holes, buries bodies.
cards.power: Pragmatism: Cancel any 'Magic' or 'Lore' effect played against you. Reality checks hurt.

cards.lore: Kriemhild sewed it on to 'protect' him. Hagen used it as a bullseye. Loose lips sink ships.
cards.power: Marked for Death: Attach to Siegfried. Attacks against him gain +5 Damage.

cards.lore: A fake invasion to get the hero out of the house. The oldest trick in the book.
cards.power: Distraction: Force opponents to tap out/rest their strongest card for a turn.

cards.lore: We're just going for a run. Take a drink. Don't worry about your weapon. Or your back.
cards.power: Ambush Location: +3 Attack if played in a 'Forest' biome.

cards.lore: A coward's blow. But it worked. Honor is for dead people.
cards.power: Assassination: Destroy a Hero card that has 'The Cross on the Robe' attached.

cards.lore: Hagen had him dumped right at Kriemhild's door. That's not just murder; that's sending a message.
cards.power: Trauma: Target opponent must discard their hand due to grief.

cards.lore: The cry woke the whole castle. A poodle scorned is a demon born.
cards.power: Vengeance Oath: Gain a 'Grudge' token. Each token adds +1 Attack in future rounds.

cards.lore: It was robbers. In the woods. Very tragic. Now, let's talk about inheritance.
cards.power: Denial: Negate a 'Truth' card.

cards.lore: Enough wealth to buy an army. Or destroy a kingdom. Kriemhild was using it to buy friends.
cards.power: Bribery: Pay 5 Gold to cancel an attack.

cards.lore: Hagen sank it all. If he couldn't have it, nobody could. The ultimate gatekeeping.
cards.power: The Vault: Remove all 'Treasure' cards from play. No one claims the throne.

cards.lore: Where is the gold? Ask the fish. The first major liquidity crisis in German history.
cards.power: Economic Crash: All players lose 50% of their points.

cards.lore: As long as one of us lives, the gold remains hidden. Spite is a powerful glue.
cards.power: Omerta: You cannot be forced to reveal your hand.

cards.lore: Attila. Mighty King. Scourge of God. Doesn't realize he's just a weapon in his new wife's purse.
cards.power: Horde Command: Summon 3 'Hun' tokens (1/1/1) to fight for you.

cards.lore: Come for the solstice. Stay for the massacre. Hagen knew it was a trap, but honor's stupid.
cards.power: Force an opponent to move their pieces into a 'Trap' biome. Stay for the massacre.

cards.lore: They crossed the Danube and smashed the boat. One way ticket to hell.
cards.power: Point of No Return: Once played, you cannot retreat. Fight or die.

cards.lore: Only the chaplain returns alive. Everyone else is meat. Hagen tried to drown the chaplain to prove them wrong. He failed.
cards.power: Spoiler Alert: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Keep the worst one.

cards.lore: Eat with your helmet on. Drink with your left hand. Don't mention the gold.
cards.power: Tension: No attacks this turn, but double damage next turn.

cards.lore: The Fiddler. He plays a tune that says you want to dance, but also takes your head off. The bard of the apocalypse.
cards.power: Violent Music: Your attacks count as 'Art'. Ignore armor.

cards.lore: Hagen chopped the kid's head off into the queen's lap. The diplomatic talks have concluded.
cards.power: First Blood: Start the combat phase immediately.

cards.lore: You're not locked in to fight them. You're locked in with them. The suffering begins.
cards.power: Lockdown: No one leaves the room. The round ends when only one player remains.

cards.lore: Kriemhild set the hall on fire. She's really committed to this revenge thing.
cards.power: Environment Damage: Deal 1 damage to every player at the start of every turn.

cards.lore: "Drink the blood," said Hagen. "It's better than wine." A literal quote. These people are insane.
cards.power: Desperate Measure: Heal full health by drinking the blood of fallen minions.

cards.lore: Stand by the wall. Let the roof fall in the middle. Tactical positioning in an oven.
cards.power: Bunker: Invulnerable to fire damage for 2 turns.

cards.lore: They threw 7,000 bodies down the stairs. Cleaning service is going to quit.
cards.power: High Ground: +2 Defense. You are standing on your mistakes.

cards.lore: He didn't want to fight. But then you killed all his friends. Now the Lion is awake.
cards.power: The Reluctant Hero: Starts passive. If attacked, destroys the attacker instantly.

cards.lore: Master of arms. Too old for this nonsense, but too loyal to leave.
cards.power: Veteran Instinct: Reroll any failed die.

cards.lore: The tragic hero. Forced to fight his friends because he promised a woman a favor. Be careful what you promise.
cards.power: Moral Conflict: Choose: Fight and die, or Refuse and die.

cards.lore: Captured by Dietrich. Tied up. The fighting is over. The suffering begins.
cards.power: Capture: The game ends for these characters. Move to execution phase.

cards.lore: She cut off her brother's head to make a point. The point being: She has lost her mind.
cards.power: Proof: Discard this card to force Hagen to speak. (Spoiler: He won't.)

cards.lore: She took the sword from Hagen. The sword her husband owned. Poetic justice, written in blood.
cards.power: Execution: Kill a defenseless prisoner. Gain no Honor.

cards.lore: Now Gunther is dead, and I am the only one who knows where the gold is. And I'm taking it to hell. You lose.
cards.power: Last Word: Even if you lose, the opponent loses 6 points. She has the victory.

cards.lore: Hildebrand couldn't watch a hero like Hagen die at a woman's hand. So he hacked Kriemhild to pieces. Chivalry is weird.
cards.power: Sudden Death: Eliminate the winner of the previous duel.

cards.lore: King Etzel and Dietrich wept. For friends and foes. A lot of crying for a heavy metal album cover.
cards.power: Mourning: Skip 3 turns. Contemplate existence.

cards.lore: What did we learn? Don't steal gold. Don't trust badgers. And family reunions suck.
cards.power: Nullify: Cancel the entire game. No one wins.

cards.lore: The Nibelungen. It never ends. It just reboots.
cards.power: New Game: Shuffle all cards and start over. Maybe this time Siegfried wears back armor.

cards.lore: I cut this up so you could play with it. Don't look at me like that. You bought the expansion.
cards.power: Rule Breaker: Change one rule of the game.

cards.lore: The driving force of the entire plot. If anyone had just gone to therapy, thousands would be alive.
cards.power: Ego Boost: +8 Attack, but you cannot retreat or heal. Ever.

cards.lore: Why didn't they shoot him earlier? Because the script said no.
cards.power: Narrative Necessity: You cannot die until act 5.

cards.lore: It's not about winning. It's about enduring the inevitable doom with a stoic face.
cards.power: Weltschmerz: All players lose 1 morale token.

cards.lore: Is it the Gold? The Ring? The Belt? Doesn't matter. It's just the thing that makes people kill each other.
cards.power: Wildcard: Assign any value to this card.

title: Nibelungen Booster Pack
